## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 20, 2026 - Jul 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Wasim Ahmed_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "very worst experience no help true help support even though opening and savings account but freezing the freaking incoming transactions then what the mean of that account and even after providing the necessary documents still no solution for that worst help support closing the account and uninstalling the app 😠"
            2. _ubaidullah md._, Jul 20, 2026, 1/5: "I deposited funds on slice savings account with the idea to save more but due to regular transactions they disabled my incoming transactions and adding funds to savings was frozen. This was very inconvenient as I had to withdraw my funds from the account due to safety reasons. Even after sending out my bank statements via email as proof they refused to unfreeze my savings account. Very disappointed with the customer retention policy and i conclude this app to be unreliable for long term use."
            3. _Priyanka Dhillon_, Jul 29, 2026, 4/5: "I love the app! Downloads are now faster and more stable 🛢, which makes a big difference in daily use. Previously, syncing happened almost every time you opened the app, started, stopped, or edited an entry, and it was very frustrating. The app would completely stop responding during syncing, making it unusable until it finished. Also, stopping an entry took several seconds, and those extra seconds were still added. Huge thanks to everyone behind the algorithms."
